ratings.comment: Never met professor, the TA's will rip your heart out and ruin your mental health. This was a required class and was the worst class I had ever taken. Only thing I learned was that I suck at art.

Am non-design student. Class was hybrid: online prerecorded lectures & in-person studio sessions w/ TA. Class consists of weekly quizzes on the boring lectures and 4 studio projects. Projects are extremely time consuming and require lots of digital art knowledge (which I had none of). TAs are rough graders who take off points without explaining why

I'm not a design student, but I decided to take this because I thought it would be a useful skill. It can be a bit intimidating with the design students, but as someone who had no skills coming it they really teach you and there's a lot of time to improve. Get ready to work with computer based designs though. The TA's can be tough graders too.
I had her at UW-Stevens Point. She is my favorite professor. Don't skip lectures or leave early she gives extra credit to the people that stay for the whole two and a half hours.

When I had Liz for the History of Interiors Class, I was beyond inspired in the field of historic design. She is very detailed and gives great information that is incredibly interesting, and this makes tests easy to study for and pass.  I am so sad that she isn't teaching this particular class anymore, but I'm positive she would be great otherwise.

I had Liz as a TA (I was in the honors section) and she was a gem-so passionate. Quizzes and tests are a little tough, but reasonable. Notecards are vey helpful. I didn't go to lecture a lot, but I had the book and did very well. 2 papers to do (analyzing a piece of art) but they're pretty short and simple. Try to have Liz as a TA!

YOU MUST ATTEND LECTURES (and pay close attention) or you will be totally lost.  Taking good notes is also crucial.  Her quizzes and exams are extremely difficult (cover A LOT of material and must memorize a lot on information such as dates, names, significance, and places) and you have to dedicate A LOT of time to this class. Notecards help a lot.

MUST ATTEND LECTURES. Don't need to buy the book, she even told us that we were not going to use it -- but unfort. it was too late to return it. The tests are VERY difficult, even if you go to every lecture. She is passionate about the material, but very spacey.
She is very nice lady and a good teacher. But her exams are too difficult even if you go to all classes.
Very straight-forward and helpful. Her exams aren't easy, but if you go to class, take good notes, and study, you'll do fine.
